correctness.rationale: From renewal identity ∑_{n≥1}u_n z^n=G(z)/(1−G(z))=z F(1−z), F(s)=λ/(s^q+λs). The slit-plane boundary jump at s=−x gives strictly positive density w(x)=λ sin(πq)x^(−q)/{π[1−2λx^(1−q)cos(πq)+λ²x^(2−2q)]}. Sectoral O(|s|^(−q)) at zero and O(|s|^(−1)) at infinity justify the keyhole Stieltjes formula; sF(s)→1 and monotone convergence normalize its total mass. Generating coefficient comparison gives u_n=∫(1+x)^(−n) w(x)dx for every n≥0, implying strict sign of all nonzero forward differences. Renewal independence gives E I_tI_(t+h)=u_tu_h, hence Cov=u_t(u_h−u_(t+h))>0. Small-x density asymptotic gives u_n~λn^(q−1)/Γ(q), yielding Corr(I_t,I_(t+h))→u_h for fixed h, with ∑_h u_h=∞. q=1 yields independent geometric Bernoulli arrivals. Independently numerically integrated q=1/2,λ=0.7 first moments [1,0.41176470588,0.29065743945,0.23544677387,0.20270800158]; checked strict initial differences, not asymptotics.
residual_risks: The autocorrelation limit is nonstationary fixed-lag aging, not stationary long-range dependence or a count-process correlation statement.
Independent numerical moments cannot certify contour analytic continuation or infinite asymptotics.

originality.rationale: Yoshida introduces precisely the model and gives its waiting PGF and discrete fractional Poisson count distributions, but the full read HTML treats correlations as a future direction. Pachon–Polito–Ricciuti examine related fractional semi-Markov counts/inverse Sibuya models, not the renewal-epoch indicator considered here. Ferreira general complete-monotonicity machinery is a possible source of implicit spectral coverage and was not successfully read in full; the model-specific positive density plus regeneration aging law appears a genuine combined refinement.
residual_risks: Ferreira general discrete complete-monotonicity result was not fully accessed and might directly imply the spectral component.
A differently named classical renewal-sequence moment theorem could subsume the special density, though inspected sources did not demonstrate decisive coverage.
